footnotes.english: Getting the behavior right across different browsers and languages is a different story! But, ideally, the end- user experience should be the same for everyone.

footnotes.after: 只要备好两种浏览器的配置，在 Firefox 中测试 Gmail 的行为，并不比在 Chrome 中更费力。
footnotes.englishAfter: Testing the behavior of Gmail in Firefox requires no more effort than doing so in Chrome, provided you have configurations for both of these systems.

footnotes.english: Technically, we have four sizes of test at Google: small, medium, large, and enormous. The internal difference between large and enormous is actually subtle and historical; so, in this book, most descriptions of large actually apply to our notion of enormous.
footnotes.chinese: 严格来说，谷歌有四种规模的测试：小型、中型、大型和超大型。在内部分类中，大型与超大型的区别其实很细微，也有历史原因。因此，本书对大型测试的多数描述，实际上对应谷歌内部的超大型测试。
footnotes.after: 而大型测试不受运行位置限制，如图11-2所示。

footnotes.english: Keep in mind that there are different kinds of coverage (line, path, branch, etc.), and each says something different about which code has been tested. In this simple example, line coverage is being used.
footnotes.chinese: 要注意，覆盖率有行覆盖率、路径覆盖率、分支覆盖率等不同类型，各自从不同角度反映哪些代码经过了测试。这个简单示例使用的是行覆盖率。
footnotes.after: 例如，100行代码中有90行被测试执行，代码覆盖率就是90%。

footnotes.english: Each supported language at Google has one standard test framework and one standard mocking/stubbing library. One set of infrastructure runs most tests in all languages across the entire codebase.
footnotes.chinese: 谷歌为每种支持的语言提供一个标准测试框架和一个标准 mock／stub 库，并用同一套基础设施运行整个代码库中各种语言的大多数测试。
footnotes.after: 减少需要支持的框架和工具数量，也能让用于改进的时间发挥更大价值。
